name: @nicotine/bridge
description: WebSocket bridge that speaks the Soulseek (SLSK) protocol for login.

scripts.build: bun build src/server.ts --target=bun --outdir dist --format=esm && mkdir -p dist/data && cp -n src/data/ip_country_data.csv dist/data/ip_country_data.csv 2>/dev/null || echo 'GeoIP csv not found locally — docker will fetch at build'
scripts.fetch:geoip: mkdir -p src/data && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicotine-plus/nicotine-plus/master/pynicotine/external/data/ip_country_data.csv -o src/data/ip_country_data.csv || wget -qO src/data/ip_country_data.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nicotine-plus/nicotine-plus/master/pynicotine/external/data/ip_country_data.csv || echo 'fetch failed'
